newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Goldman has Ericsson as priority - source.
newsitem.headline: Goldman has Ericsson as priority - source.

text.p: Goldman Sachs has put Swedish telecoms group LM Ericsson Ab on its priority list, a market source said on Friday.
The Goldman rating is an upgrade to the priority list from market outperformer.
Ericsson spokesman Per Bengtsson said he saw no particular reason for the change in recommendation.

"I haven't seen any motivation why Goldman Sachs has changed its opinion about Ericsson. There is no particular order or anything we have made public that could have made any impact of sort," Bengtsson told Reuters.
Ericsson shares were 8.5 crowns higher at 187 crowns at 1035 GMT.
